list.title: Budget
list.basedOnHint: The copy stands on its own and does not remember where it came from. Comments are not copied.
list.importHint: A past budget as one row per line: cost_center, account, description and either an amount or antal x á-pris. The year and the name are taken from the file name.
list.importFailed: The budget could not be imported
list.imported: Imported {sheets} cost centers, {accounts} accounts and {lines} rows.
list.importUnmatched: {count} cost centers have no match and were imported unlinked ({codes}). An unlinked cost center is left out of the outcome comparison.
list.importProblems: {count} rows could not be read and were skipped. First one on line {first}
list.deleteMessage: The budget and all its rows are permanently deleted. Other budgets are unaffected.
list.emptyNone: No budget has been created yet.

compare.title: Compare budgets
compare.addBudgetAria: Add a budget to the comparison
compare.pickTwo: Pick at least two budgets to compare.

sheet.changeAdoptedAt: Change the date it was adopted
sheet.invalidAdoptedAt: The date has to be written as YYYY-MM-DD.
sheet.cloned: Cost center cloned. Pick which cost center the copy is for.
sheet.cloneFailed: Could not clone the cost center
sheet.markedRows: {count, plural, one {# row selected} other {# rows selected}}
sheet.markedAccounts: {count, plural, one {# account selected} other {# accounts selected}}
sheet.copiedRows: {count, plural, one {# row copied} other {# rows copied}}
sheet.copiedAccounts: {count, plural, one {# account copied} other {# accounts copied}}
sheet.pasteRowsHint: Stand in an account and press ⌘/Ctrl+V to paste them there.
sheet.pasteAccountsHint: Open another cost center and press ⌘/Ctrl+V to paste them there.
sheet.pasteNeedsAccount: Stand in a row or an account to paste into.
sheet.removeMessage: The accounts and rows on the sheet are permanently deleted. Other budgets are unaffected.
sheet.dragToReorder: Drag to move the row or reorder
sheet.emptyChart: The chart of accounts is empty. Sync it under Settings → Fortnox
sheet.incompleteSum: incomplete – a row could not be computed

rambudget.changesHint: How much of the result comes from editorial changes

changes.title: Editorial changes
changes.label: {kind, select, AVSTEG {Deviation} other {Transfer}} #{seq}

kindHint.AVSTEG: The frame budget moves. Name the entry that changes: plus for more, minus for less.
kindHint.FORFLYTTNING: The frame budget must stand still: the entries have to cancel out and sit within the same result unit.

changes.unchanged: The budget is unchanged since it was locked.
changes.summary: {count, plural, one {# change in force} other {# changes in force}} – the frame budget {effect}
changes.explainer: You don't edit a locked budget, you add to it. A budget deviation adjusts an entry so the frame budget moves, while a budget transfer shifts money between entries within one result unit and leaves the frame budget where it is. Both show up on the cost center's sheet, as rows of their own under the entries they change.
changes.reasonHint: Stays in the history, on the sheet and in every future copy of the budget.
changes.reasonPlaceholder: Why is this change being made?
changes.noSheets: No cost centers in the budget
changes.empty: No editorial changes have been made.
changes.revokeMessage: The amounts stop counting immediately. The change is not removed from the history. It stays, struck through, with who revoked it and when.

eval.circular: The budget has circular dependencies. Some values may be wrong.
